messages.content: What is the freezing point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure, provided in kilopascals (kPa) or atmospheres (atm). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
The freezing point of water at 10 kPa (≈ 0.1 atm) is roughly **–20 °C**.  
At this pressure the solid–liquid equilibrium line on the water phase diagram lies well below the normal 0 °C melting point, so ice melts (or water freezes) at about –20 °C.  

*(Note: the provided `thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point` function only returns boiling points, not freezing points.)*
